ruleBlocks.text: Second Conditional описывает нереальные или маловероятные ситуации в настоящем/будущем: if + Past Simple, would + V1. Third Conditional описывает нереальные ситуации в прошлом (сожаление): if + had + V3, would have + V3.

ruleBlocks.caption: Формулы
rows: If I had more time, I would learn Spanish.
If + had + V3, would have + V3
If she had left earlier, she would have caught the train.
were для всех лиц в formal style
If I were you, I would apologize.

ruleBlocks.title: Как различать
lines: Third: уже в прошлом, изменить нельзя

items.en: If I were taller, I would play basketball.
items.ru: Если бы я был выше, я бы играл в баскетбол.

items.en: If they had prepared better, they would have won.
items.ru: Если бы они лучше подготовились, они бы победили.

items.en: If you were in my place, what would you do?
items.ru: Если бы ты был на моем месте, что бы ты сделал?

items.en: If we had booked earlier, we would have paid less.
items.ru: Если бы мы забронировали раньше, мы бы заплатили меньше.

items.prompt: If I had a car, I would drive to work.
items.explain: Нереальная ситуация в настоящем -> Second Conditional.

items.prompt: If he had called me, I would have helped him.
If I were you, I would not wait.
If we had left at 6, we would have arrived on time.
items.explain: Прошлое действие не случилось -> Third Conditional.

items.prompt: If she were more confident, she would apply for that job.
If I had known about the meeting, I would have come.
items.explain: Had known + would have come -> Third Conditional.

items.prompt: If I were you, I ____ (talk) to her.
items.explain: Second Conditional: if + past, would + V1.

items.prompt: If they had more money, they ____ (travel) more.
If she had studied harder, she ____ (pass) the exam.
items.explain: Third Conditional: if + had V3, would have V3.

items.prompt: If we hadn't missed the bus, we ____ (be) here on time.
If I would know, I would tell you.
accepted: If I knew, I would tell you.

items.prompt: If he had seen the sign, he would stop.
accepted: If he had seen the sign, he would have stopped.
items.explain: Для Third Conditional в результате нужна форма would have + V3.
